Walker, mostly. I can do a few stairs if there's a rail, but a bunk up top is out, and I can't do a long walk to a bus stop.
Got it. A walker, a rail for a few stairs, no top bunk, and no long walk to a bus. That helps a lot. Which city were you living in before you came here?
Santa Ana, mostly. I had a room there for a while, then I lost it, and that's when I ended up under the bridge.
Santa Ana. Thank you, that helps. Do you have any ID with you, like a state ID or a card with your name on it?
No, I lost my ID a while back. Everything got taken when I was under the bridge. I've got my Medi-Cal card, though, I think it's still in my coat pocket.
Okay, you've got your Medi-Cal card in your coat, and no state ID right now. Thanks for telling me. Next, about how old are you? A range is fine, like your 30s or over 60.
Sixty-two.
Sixty-two. Thank you. Do you have a phone, like a flip phone or a smartphone, or no phone right now?
Just a basic phone. It's a flip phone, and it only does calls and texts. It's old, but it still works.

Here's what I heard: You're leaving Friday. You can't go back under the bridge. You use a walker, can do a few stairs with a rail, can't use a top bunk, and can't walk far to a bus. You lived in Santa Ana. You lost your ID. Your Medi-Cal card is in your coat. You're 62. You have a flip phone that calls and texts. Did I get that right?
Yes, that's all right. Only thing I'd add is the Medi-Cal card might be in my coat, so I'd want to check on that before Friday.
Got it. I'll make a note that your Medi-Cal card might be in your coat, and that you want to check on it before Friday. Thanks, that's everything I need. I'll find your next step now.
